title: But I Don’t Code
next: Next: the chat box is not the toolbox.

scenes.text: “AI is for developers.” Lovely. Can you think rationally? Can you say what you want, and what the finished thing looks like?
Then you’re qualified. The skill isn’t syntax. It’s describing the outcome in enough detail that nobody has to guess.
Where was I? Exactly. Long briefs get lost when you get interrupted. Write it down first, then paste it in.
